FUEL PUMP REMOVAL

CAUTION: Do not smoke or work near an open flame when
working on the fuel pump.
1. TAKE OUT FLOOR CARPET
2. REMOVE SPARE WHEEL COVER
3. REMOVE SPARE WHEEL
4. REMOVE SERVICE HOLE COVER
